    Call println
      Var label

      Binary Eq
        FieldAccess file
          Var location
        Var expectedFile
    Call println
      FieldAccess line
        Var location

      FieldAccess column
        Var location
    Call println
      FieldAccess functionName
        Var location
    Call println
      FieldAccess typeName
        Var location
  fun trace(location: SourceLocation = <expr>): SourceLocation
    =
      Var location
  fun warn(location: SourceLocation = <expr>): SourceLocation
    =
      Call trace
        Var location
  fun relay(location: SourceLocation = <expr>): SourceLocation
    =
      Call warn
        Var location
  fun genericBody<T>(value: T): SourceLocation
    =
      Call getCurrentSourceLocation
  class Reporter()
    fun bodyLocation
    fun defaultLocation
  class LocationTask(), SuspendTask<SourceLocation>
    public suspend fun run
  class LocationCompletion(val expectedFile: String), Continuation<SourceLocation>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException

    val direct
